name: Whispers in the fog
detailed_description:
Whispers in the Fog is a first-person, psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and unraveling a deeply personal mystery.

You awaken in a foggy rainy forest, your memory is a blank slate, armed with nothing but a flashlight. The thick, eerie woods pulse with haunting whispers. Shadowy figures dart through the mist at unnatural speeds, amplifying the dread of being utterly lost, with no map explore the vast surroundings. Follow faint whispers through the dense fog as you uncover clues scattered across decaying landmarks, forgotten trails, and eerie structures. Strange artifacts, torn journal pages, and cryptic symbols begin to reveal fragments of a hidden truth that challenges your perception of reality.

Each path leads to a deeper layer of the unknown. Abandoned villages, cursed tunnels, and rotting cabins hide puzzles and remnants of those who came before you... and never left. But be careful some voices guide you and others deceive. Shadow figures linger just beyond the trees, watching, waiting.

Explore the surroundings and unravel the mystery of your journey 

Every step forward brings you closer to the truth... but some truths are better left buried.

There are no traditional combat systems. Instead, survival depends on observation, memory, and the courage to move forward despite the voices that beg you to turn back.

Gameplay

Players begin with nothing but a flashlight and a worn backpack, gradually collecting items, clues, and tools that aid in solving environmental puzzles scattered throughout a sprawling, open-ended forest. Each location whether an abandoned village, decaying asylum, or foggy cemetery tells its own silent story through visual storytelling and interactive elements.

Atmosphere and Lighting 

The atmosphere and lighting of the game will have realistic dynamic weather state that will change based on your location and points of interest. Every environment is crafted to evoke unease, isolation, and quiet dread where the fog is not just a visual element, but a character in itself.

From the moment players awaken in the rain soaked forest, the world feels heavy and uncertain. Light is scarce, filtered through clouds and mist, with only a flashlight to push back the darkness. Shadows stretch unnaturally. Hidden figures blend into the trees. Distant lights beacon but not always to safety.

Features 

Atmospheric First-Person Horror
Immerse yourself in a haunting, fog drenched forest where light is scarce, shadows linger, and every sound could mean danger or discovery.

Environmental Puzzle Solving
Solve layered, narrative driven puzzles using clues hidden in the world. Objects, symbols, and notes are seamlessly integrated into the environment, encouraging exploration and attention to detail.

Psychological Sound Design
3D spatial audio and unsettling ambient soundscapes blur the line between reality and hallucination. Whispers may guide you or mislead you.

Cinematic Lighting and Fog Effects
Powered by cutting-edge technology with Unreal Engine 5 dynamic lighting and volumetric fog, each scene is visually crafted to build suspense and emotional tension.

Fragmented Narrative
Discover scattered journal entries, personal belongings, and hidden memories as you piece together the truth behind your journey and identity.

Nonlinear Exploration
Choose your own path through a vast, interconnected world filled with abandoned cabins, tunnels, villages, and forgotten ruins each with its own dark story to tell.

Minimal UI, Maximum Immersion
Inventory system keeps players immersed, with a physical backpack and a journal for managing clues and key items.

Subtle Horror, Lasting Impact
No jump scare overload just creeping dread, psychological unease, and moments that stay with you long after the game is over.

short_description: Whispers in the fog is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious forest with haunted locations that will give you a terrifying experience. With realistic atmosphere, scary encounters and only a flashlight to light your way, unravel the mystery that is beyond the forest.
